content_md:
🤖 Two Zammad 0-days (CVE-2026-102489, CVE-2026-102490) chained to hijack sessions, run code and escalate to root on DIVD's network in second

via Mastodon https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/divd-says-zammad-zero-days-enabled-ai-driven-network-breach/

CVE-2026-102489.evidence: Chained with CVE-2026-102490 to hijack sessions and escalate to root during the observed breach of DIVD's network.

CVE-2026-102490.evidence: Chained with CVE-2026-102489 in the observed DIVD compromise, per BleepingComputer.
